title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
Starting the MDS program has been an exciting and slightly overwhelming experience. During orientation week, I met my cohort and got a sense of the pace and structure of the program. The first week of classes was a mix of excitement and adjustment. What surprised me most was the quality of contents and lectures. Now two weeks have passed, I’m starting to feel more settled.

title: About Me
text: I grew up in Iran and before joining MDS, I worked at non profitable and tech industries. I decided to pursue data science because of my interest in marketing and data analytics. When I’m not coding or studying, you can find me cooking and baking and exploring new places.

title: worldinmarketing
text: Hi, I’m Maryam! I’m a Master’s student in Data Science at UBC. Before starting the program, I studied marketing and worked as a marketing manager for 5 years. I’m passionate about using data to solve real-world problems, and I’m excited to build on my background in marketing analytics here at MDS.
